verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain
The One who broke down
The great wall of enmity
And gave me His name

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
How gracious is my Redeemer
King Jesus, the Son of the Highest
What could I possibly give to You
But the fragrance of my hallelujah
Hallelujah

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Holy is the Man of Sorrows
Destroying the works of the evil one
All with Your own blood

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
And mercies before and behind You
Such beauty all around You
And how could I ever repay You
But with the fragrance of my hallelujah
Hallelujah

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Praise be to the Wounded One
All glory and honor to the Son
We ascribe worth and give love to You, Lord
Let the fragrance of our love go forth

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
We lift our gaze, we lift our gaze
We lift our gaze to You

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
You are higher, You are higher
You are higher, You are higher

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
So I pour out all my worship over You
And I sing my song of worship straight to You

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
We pour our love on You
In the middle of the night

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
Thank You for the price You paid
Thank You for the love You gave

verse.name: o4
verse.lines:
Praise, praise, praise
Now my heart it overflows with Your praise
